name: TEDA Nangang Group (天津经济技术开发区南港发展集团有限公司)
via: actual controller is the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Bureau of Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area (TEDA SASAC), per Tencent News (17 March 2026); the TEDA development zone formed the group in June 2020, per the zone's own recruitment announcement
note: Operator of the Nangang industrial zone in Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area; its wordmark 泰达南港集团 is on Tianjin Jinmen Tiger's 2026 shirt (Tencent News, 17 March 2026; Football Daily, 9 March 2026).
